messages:
ellie.r: Received invoice from VertexStream (INV-2026-99) for $6,200 but no PO number on PDF. PDF link: https://files.redwood/vertex/INV-2026-99.pdf

tom.proc: Was there a PO for VertexStream? I don't see one in procurement. We used a purchase request but it stalled on approver.

maria.ap: AP can't match without PO. Also vendor name on invoice is 'Vertex Stream Ltd' but our vendor file is 'VERTEXSTREAM INC'. Matching fails.

tom.proc: I can raise an urgent PO if we have approver. Created PO draft 6123 and set as expedited. Link: https://proc.redwood/purchase/6123

legal-bot: Quick check: vendor entity mismatch flagged. If vendor is EU entity, tax implications differ. Please confirm billing entity before issuing PO.

ellie.r: Eng needs this for model eval data ingestion. We prefer fast route. Can procurement create PO and tie to US entity and ask vendor to reissue?

maria.ap: AP policy: invoices >$5k require either PO match or CFO approval. Approvals-bot, route PO 6123 to cfo for one-off approval if vendor can't reissue.

approvals-bot: PO 6123 routed to cfo at 2026-09-10 14:05 UTC. Status: PENDING.

tom.proc: Vendor replied: they can reissue under 'VERTEXSTREAM INC' and include PO number. Asked for billing contact. I sent data-team@redwood.

ellie.r: Vendor uploaded corrected invoice INV-2026-99-US.pdf with PO 6123 at 14:40. Link: https://files.redwood/vertex/INV-2026-99-US.pdf

maria.ap: AP matched invoice to PO 6123 and scheduled for next payment run. Removed hold at 14:45. Will code to GL 6110 (third-party data).

tom.proc: Procurement updated vendor record to 'VERTEXSTREAM INC' and added note: "prefer US billing, include PO on invoices". Closing ticket.

ellie.r: Thanks everyone. Please update me when payment posts so we can close the procurement request. :thumbsup:
